raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Since batch 13 reversals arrive as separate REVERSAL rows with orig_txn_id, and the original transactions stay POSTED, so they are still counted. The silver filter on status='POSTED' only drops REVERSAL rows and the older REVERSED rows, so recent days are overstated. The fix excludes POSTED originals that have a matching REVERSAL, which matches how REVERSED originals are already excluded.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.75,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions r WHERE status = 'POSTED' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw_transactions v WHERE v.status = 'REVERSAL' AND v.orig_txn_id = r.txn_id)"}}
